name: AMD iGPU · Use swangle rendering (Example)
author: ApkStart
description: On some AMD integrated GPUs with older drivers, -gpu host passes emulator self-check, but the process crashes ~10s after guest boots. Pinning rendering backend to swangle works around this at the cost of slightly lower framerate.
name: AMD 核显 · 改用 swangle 渲染（示例）
author: ApkStart
description: 部分 AMD 核显 + 老驱动下，-gpu host 能通过 emulator 自检，但 guest 起来十几秒后进程直接崩溃（日志里只有 AEHD is operational）。把渲染后端固定成 swangle 可以绕过，代价是帧率略低。

notes: If rendering is normal but games lag, try setting Render Size to 540x960 in settings
Once verified, change enabled to true or delete that line to activate automatically
如果画面正常但游戏很卡，可以在设置里把「画质」调成 540×960
确认可用后，把 enabled 改成 true 或删掉这一行，就能自动生效
